column1: # The letters and figures, as marks (the user, 25 November 2026): each
# stands alone, no ground, ring or frame round it, as large as the icons
# beside it; drawn with the icons' one stroke, every corner round by 3.5,
# its inner spaces large and square (a p's bowl a rounded square, not a
# pill). The m's arches stand apart, each its own stroke, as the font's
# open m. The letter's box: sides 4.5 and 19.5; ascender 3, x-height
# 6.5, line 17.5, descender 21. A mark stands for a name with no picture
# of its own. Read with icon.tsv as one table.
